motivation: Confirm the frozen Stage 7 baseline settings and frozen Stage 8 BOTA response scale across three model seeds on Development before deciding whether a new FinalTest evaluation is justified.

stage9_confirmation.sisa_policy: Stage 7 found no eligible SISA configuration. No failed SISA candidate is promoted or rerun as a selected configuration; its no-eligible result remains part of the audit.

development_partition.policy: The same frozen example partition is used for every model seed; only model/adaptation randomness changes.

requirements: BOTA passes both utility guardrails without prediction collapse in every held-out seed-by-scenario cell.
BOTA has normalized local residual below 1 in every held-out seed-by-scenario cell.
Across the four held-out seed-by-scenario cells, BOTA has lower unweighted mean E_U than each frozen eligible baseline.
stability_decision.selection_seed_role: Seed 42 is reported for the three-seed aggregate but is excluded from the binary confirmation decision because it selected the settings.
stability_decision.failure_policy: Report the full matrix and do not authorize a new FinalTest evaluation.

required_reporting: all six method by three seed by two scenario cells

conditional_finaltest_policy.authorization_condition: Stage 9 status is STABLE_CONFIRMED under the frozen rule above.
conditional_finaltest_policy.next_action_if_authorized: Create and commit a new dated amendment that fixes the FinalTest endpoints, methods, metrics, aggregation, stopping rule and one-shot access policy before opening FinalTest.
conditional_finaltest_policy.prohibited_action: Do not inspect or evaluate FinalTest while Stage 9 is running or before that later amendment is committed.

interpretation_rules: Stage 9 confirms fixed configurations; it performs no selection, retuning or request-specific calibration.
All completed and adverse outcomes must be retained and reported.
A stable Development result authorizes a separately preregistered FinalTest evaluation but does not itself establish test-set performance.
A failed confirmation cannot be repaired by silently changing a seed, scenario, baseline, response scale or decision rule.
